evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: The directive asserts self-origination over what knowledge is retained, an autonomy move: the speaker commands erasure of prior calibration knowledge on their own authority.
A directive to remove knowledge appeals to the speaker's self-directed control over what the system retains — autonomy as the motive frame.
The assertive statement rewrites the institutional record to align with a stable, corrected baseline — conservation of a consistent official history.
